q: How is Sankthans traditionally celebrated in Denmark?

options.t: People gather in the evening and light a bonfire
People hold a party and give each other presents
People dress up and hit the cat out of the barrel

answerText: People gather in the evening and light a bonfire
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 and November 2023 exams.

da.q: Hvordan fejrer man traditionelt sankthans i Danmark?
options: Man samles om aftenen og tænder bål
Man holder fest og giver hinanden gaver
Man klæder sig ud og slår katten af tønden
da.answer: Man samles om aftenen og tænder bål

learn.text: On the evening of the 23rd of June, Sankthans is celebrated.
